body:
Founder: 'can we add daisy UI... make it look like damn what app is that' / 'have a light mode and a dark mode both colorful.' Installed daisyui@5.7.37 via Tailwind v4's @plugin directive. Two real stock themes: cupcake (light, default) / dracula (dark, prefers-color-scheme-aware), plus a manual localStorage-persisted toggle. Existing semantic tokens (bg/panel/line/ink/muted/gold/danger) now alias daisyUI's real CSS variables so the whole app re-themes automatically with zero per-component changes. Found+fixed one real hardcoded-color bug along the way. New docs/NOCK_STYLE_GUIDE.md, linked from NOCK_NORTHSTAR.md. Build verified (caught a real daisyUI v5 API change -- no more -bordered modifiers -- during the build step). Commit 1f5942f.

⚓ ☃
title: Ship daisyUI theming for NOCK (cupcake/dracula)
